recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Future work should address only specific later Device, DeviceDefinition, or UDI trackers; FHIR-15812 itself does not identify a remaining current-spec source defect.
issue_request: FHIR-15812 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification STU3 Device issue asking whether merging Device and DeviceComponent would solve modeling for multi-part devices. It proposed representing device modules as Device resources linked by a parent relationship, with UDI, type, version, production specification, and other instance data available on parent or sub-component devices. The final resolution said this had already been done.
initial_application: No source commit in the local history explicitly mentions FHIR-15812. The issue appears to have been applied through the broader R4 Device rework: DeviceDefinition was added, DeviceComponent was removed from active resource/navigation listings, and Device narrative was updated to say Device can represent a whole device or a component that points to its parent.
additional_context: Device and DeviceDefinition are active OO-owned resources in source/fhir.ini, while DeviceComponent is commented out. Current Device narrative distinguishes Device instances from DeviceDefinition kind/model definitions and says component Devices point to their parent. Device.parent is a 0..1 Reference(Device), and Device retains identifiers, repeatable UDI carriers, type, version, and property data. OO minutes and Zulip discussions corroborate that DeviceComponent was merged into Device for R4.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already supports hierarchical sub-component devices using Device.parent, separates kind/model data into DeviceDefinition, and keeps the relevant UDI and instance data on Device.

related_jiras.note: Published STU3 issue about multiple UDIs for complex devices; its resolution says the Device/DeviceDefinition UDI model and Device parent option satisfied the concern.
